skills.name: Grave Digger
skills.raw_text: Available with all weapons Type Active Element Neutral MP 100 $result_string .= sprintf("Aggro %s", $row['aggro_text']); Combo start Yes Combo middle Yes Range 0 Description Deploys a conceptual graveyard to prepare for necromancy. Attack MP Recovery increases based on the Spirit stacks gained. Gains resistance to status ailments. Both Attack MP Recovery per Spirit stack and resistance to status ailments increase with skill level. Phantom Missile

skills.name: Fine Shovel
